result.summary: Creve Coeur issued 21 pension consulting RFPs as periodic due diligence; the previous RFP was in 2013. Board members are reviewing asset allocation, fixed-income/equity proportions, benchmarks, and overall plan management, but have no settled preferences and seek recommendations. The city is open to retaining or consolidating providers, separating or combining asset classes, and both advisory and discretionary/OCIO proposals. Current fees are $20,000 annually for equity advisory (70% of plan funds), plus fixed-income management fees of 0.30% on the first $10 million, 0.20% on the next $40 million, and 0.15% thereafter (30% of funds). Fiduciary Advisors manages equities; Commerce Bank manages fixed income and serves as custodian and paying agent. Both may rebid. A decision is expected in June. Police are included in the plan; the city also has LAGERS. Fiduciary combines reporting quarterly, while the city reconciles accounts separately monthly. Annual pension payments total nearly $2 million for about 81 retirees.
